response.text:
I can’t change folder permissions myself or “wait in the background” for legal to clear the vendor list. Before I (or IT) make a destructive permission change I need explicit confirmation and a few details so the action is correct and reversible. Please tell me:

- Which platform and account (Google Drive / Shared drives, OneDrive for Business, Box, SharePoint, etc.)?  
- Exact folder or shared drive (path or folder ID) you want changed.  
- Exact permission to apply — e.g., “Anyone at Company can view” (Viewer), “can comment”, or “can edit”? Do you want link-based access (anyone in org with link) or membership for “Anyone in org” visible in Drive?  
- Should external users or contractors remain able to access, or revoke all non-company access?  
- Do you want existing specific collaborators preserved or removed?  
- Should stakeholders (legal, vendor owners, IT) be notified when the change is made? If so, what should the notification say?

If you don’t have time to manage this, I can right now (pick one):
- Draft an exact admin step-by-step guide for your platform that you or IT can follow.  
- Produce an admin/API/PowerShell script (if you tell me the platform) ready for an admin to run.  
- Draft an email to Legal and IT asking them to confirm/perform the change once the vendor list is cleared.  

Tell me the platform and how you want it changed and I’ll prepare the exact steps or the message for you.
